items.description: Translation from Spanish to English, 68 lines
items.rationale: Translating supporting documents for the claim is excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f); Part 11.2 identifies this charge explicitly.
Working materials raised alongside the translation charge are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Robbery under threat of a weapon is covered (2.3.1). The watch is capped at the EUR 2,500 per-item valuables sub-limit (4.2.2, no valuables schedule); cash over EUR 800 is capped at the EUR 500 means-of-payment sub-limit (4.2.3). The total of 3,000 is within the 5,000 away-from-premises limit (4.2.4). Less the EUR 50 deductible (7.8): 2,950.
Forwarding and carriage charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b); Part 11.2 flags this ancillary forwarding charge.
